title: The symmetric Young character containment conjecture for Frobenius-exact tensor categories
statement:
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a Frobenius-exact tensor category. For each $n$, let $\mathbf{B}^n[\mathcal{C}]$ denote the associated class of symmetric-group representations, and let $\mathbf{SYoung}^n$ be the subgroup of the representation ring generated by symmetric Young representations. Write

$$
\mathbf{B}[\mathcal{C}]=\bigcup_n\mathbf{B}^n[\mathcal{C}],\qquad \mathbf{SYoung}=\bigcup_n\mathbf{SYoung}^n.
$$

**Symmetric Young containment conjecture.** If

$$
\mathbf{B}^p[\mathcal{C}]\subset\mathbf{SYoung}^p,
$$

then

$$
\mathbf{B}[\mathcal{C}]\subset\mathbf{SYoung}.
$$

The statement proposes that the symmetric Young containment condition in degree $p$ propagates to all degrees. The supplied text gives no resolution evidence, so its status remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.00892

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of June 2024).
source_name: Kevin Coulembier, “Inductive systems of the symmetric group, polynomial functors and tensor categories”, arXiv:2406.00892 (2026).
